meta.descripcion: The first Porsche 911 reimagined from end to end by Valentín Motors. Unveiled in Madrid in November 2025.

parrafos: The PA10/01 is the first Porsche 911 we have reimagined from end to end: body, mechanics, interior and every detail decided and carried out in-house. It is not a commission: it is what happens when we are the client.
It was unveiled at a private event at our Madrid premises in November 2025, before clients and the specialist press.
Cream exterior, with fibreglass bumpers and amber indicators, Fuchs wheels and a ducktail spoiler. Inside, tartan and burgundy leather, with an engraved door pull. The cooling fan, in ivory.
Each of those decisions was made in the design department and carried out between the paint booth, the engine room and the upholstery shop.

secciones.titulo: What it means for a commission
parrafos: The PA10/01 is not for sale, but it serves as a reference. It is the long answer to the question of how far a restomod built here can go, and the starting point for any conversation about a project of this kind.
